name: MvPolynomial.coeff_aeval_X_mul
source:
private lemma coeff_aeval_X_mul (i : σ) (f : Polynomial R) (B : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (hB : ∀ e ∈ B.support, e i = 0) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    (Polynomial.aeval (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) f * B).coeff d =
      f.coeff (d i) * B.coeff (d.erase i) := by
  classical
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_eq_sum, Polynomial.sum_def, Finset.sum_mul,
    coeff_sum]
  simp_rw [algebraMap_eq, X_pow_eq_monomial, C_mul_monomial, coeff_monomial_mul']
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (d i)]
  · simp [tsub_eq_of_eq_add (Finsupp.erase_add_single i d).symm]
  · intro m _ hne
    split_ifs with hle
    · rw [notMem_support_iff.1 fun h ↦ by
        simpa [Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le,
          ((Finsupp.single_le_iff.1 hle).lt_of_ne hne).not_ge] using hB _ h, mul_zero]
    · rfl
  · intro hnot
    simp [Polynomial.notMem_support_iff.1 hnot]

what: Computes the coefficient of the product of a univariate polynomial in one variable and a multivariate polynomial independent of that variable.
how: Expands Polynomial.eval₂_eq_sum and coeff_monomial_mul', then Finset.sum_eq_single selects the only possible univariate exponent; the support-independence hypothesis kills every other summand.
hypotheses: Commutative coefficients and a second factor whose every supported exponent is zero in the selected coordinate.
